title: Triangle of orbs follow him home and appear in his yard

tellings.quote: I had this video of a triangle of orbs going up and down making sure my security camera got it

plain: A man named Bob McGwier, billed on the show as a CIA contractor, says a triangle of glowing orbs followed him home to Blacksburg, Virginia, and showed up in his yard. He tells Michels he has video of the orbs going up and down as if "making sure my security camera got it." If so, the orbs were not just present but seemed to want to be recorded.
